description: Algorithmic decision tree, currency targets, and execution rules for Granblue Fantasy event automation engines (collaboration and scenario events).

collaboration.recommendedLoop: Single EX / EX+ spam + Daily 2x Maniac + 5x Multi

treasureraid.recommendedLoop: Single VH (mat farming) -> Raid EX (token farming) -> 1-click 10x Nightmare Skips

tasks.description: Ensure event story episodes 1-6 + Ending are cleared on day 1 to unlock characters and high-tier quests.
Execute daily 2/2 Maniac solo quests for high-yield medallions, character treasures, and guaranteed HELL procs.
Clear 5 Event Multi Battles to fulfill daily mission and collect 50 free Crystals.
Clear or skip procced Nightmare (HELL) battles immediately. Prioritize Lv120 for 3x Fruit Parfaits.

priorityTiers.name: Absolute Mandatory
priorityTiers.description: Event SS-Rare Ticket & Damascus Crystals (3x). Irreplaceable progression value.

priorityTiers.name: Exclusive Power & Uncap
priorityTiers.description: Event SSR Summon (1x), Event SSR Weapon (4x), Rings (Intricacy, Lineage), Earrings (Fire, Light), plus FLB materials.

priorityTiers.name: Resource Positive Farming
priorityTiers.description: Half-Elixirs (75 packs = 150 pots) & Soul Berries (100 packs = 200 berries). Yields net positive AP/EP returns.

priorityTiers.name: Progression Materials
priorityTiers.description: Coronation Rings, Steel Bricks, Psyches, JP, Merits, Cups.

priorityTiers.name: Skip / Low Value
priorityTiers.description: Elemental character uncap sets, generic islands materials, anima sets (overpriced in medallions).

medallionShortage.rationale: Single EX has the highest Medallion per AP ratio and takes < 3 seconds with 0-button Quick Summon.

secondaryTreasureShortage.rationale: Single EX+ drops 3-5 Hijikata Specials consistently per 30 AP run.

fruitParfaitShortage.rationale: HELL Lv120 guarantees 3 Fruit Parfaits per clear at 0 AP.

epDumping.rationale: Joining Koro EX+ multi raids when EP >= 5 expends unneeded raid points.

quickSummonThresholds.recommendedSummon: Triple Zero (10M plain) / Beelzebub 4★ (3M plain + uncap specs) / Yatagarasu
